description: The purpose of this loopback is to provide Industry an update concerning the previously posted Request for Information  36C10B26Q0028 - 7A20--AI Medical Coding. After consideration of the information provided and further review of VA  s requirements it was determined to not move forward with further action regarding AI Medical Coding. Please continue to monitor SAM.gov for future announcements and opportunities. Thank you to the companies that provided a response and information in support of this Information Request.
